svg.title: Star road: achievements
svg.desc: Harvard HPAIR Asia 2026: International Delegate · "Rising with Resolve". Selected as an International Delegate for the HPAIR Asia Conference 2026 from 50,000+ applications across 70+ countries. Honeywell Leadership Challenge Academy: Selectee · U.S. Space & Rocket Center, USA. One of 4 students from India among 140+ international delegates from 23+ countries, at NASA Marshall's official visitor center. HackAgentAIx: Top 14 · University of Essex, UK. Advanced from 2,000+ teams worldwide to the Top 14 and the finals of a multi-round international hackathon.
